statements.impact_statement: CVE-2026-32767 is an authorization bypass in the SiYuan personal knowledge management system, whose /api/search/fullTextSearchBlock endpoint runs user-supplied SQL; SiYuan 3.6.0 and earlier are affected and 3.6.1 fixes it (GHSA-j7wh-x834-p3r7, https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/security/advisories/GHSA-j7wh-x834-p3r7, https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-32767). It does not concern the Expat XML parser: the Debian security tracker marks it NOT-FOR-US: SiYuan (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-32767), the Alpine security tracker maps it only to the siyuan source package (https://security.alpinelinux.org/vuln/CVE-2026-32767), and Alpine's expat secfixes do not list it. This owner is Expat built from Alpine's main/expat. Unpacked all 120 packages it publishes for Alpine 3.23 on x86_64 and aarch64 (expat, libexpat, expat-dev, expat-static and expat-doc, builds 2.7.3-r0 through 2.10.0-r1): they hold the xmlwf program, the libexpat shared library, headers with CMake and pkg-config files, the static libexpat.a archive, and documentation. No file in any of them contains SiYuan code or mentions SiYuan or the fullTextSearchBlock endpoint, while the Expat version string is found in every build.
